json_ld_data.name: Tarot Candle Duo: The Hermit and The Fool
json_ld_data.description: A balance of bold beginnings and quiet reflection. The Adventure & Reflection Tarot Candle Duo pairs The Fool and The Hermit, bringing together two powerful energies for life’s journey. The Fool invites spontaneity, fresh starts, and fearless forward movement, while The Hermit encourages stillness, introspection, and reconnecting with your inner wisdom. Each candle combines original Tarot artwork, an illuminating reading, and a fragrance designed to reflect the energy of the card. Whether you are stepping into something new or taking time to pause and reflect, this duo is made to guide the moment. The Hermit features notes of Blood Orange, Wild Moss & Embers.The Fool features Tobacco Flower, Orange Peel & Leather.
